title: Advertised demo.reception cannot authenticate through MCP sandbox_call
actual: A single sandbox_call(as_user='demo.reception', GET /staff/lookup?q=DEMO) was refused before the requested read: login as demo.reception failed (INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Username or password is incorrect.). demo_accounts() still advertises demo.reception and its reception workspace. Admin read confirms exact user5 active, failed_login_count1, locked_until=null. Other demo accounts can use the same read endpoint successfully.
expected: The documented DEV demo account should work through sandbox_call, or MCP should provide a current supported account/access workflow for reception regression checks. Please reconcile the sandbox credentials/documentation or provide a separate safe fixture. Do not require developers to reset shared passwords or reseed the entire shared database.
steps: Read demo_accounts(); make sandbox_call as demo.reception, method GET, path /staff/lookup, query {q:'DEMO'}. One failure observed; no repeated sign-in attempt, password reset or reseed. As demo.it read GET /admin/users?q=demo.reception then GET /admin/users/5.
